name: Garden of Eden
source:
A tragedy in a K-pop group didn’t stop its leader. She is determined to make her comeback, reclaim her glory, and uncover the truth behind her sister’s death. Shadows gather backstage...

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Garden_of_Eden]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
韩国流行音乐组合的悲剧并没有阻止其领导人。她决心东山再起，夺回荣耀，并揭开姐姐死亡背后的真相。阴影聚集在后台……
